faqs.a:
Section 411.1. Connecting appliances,
is hereby amended by adding number 10 to read as follows:
"10. Gas piping to all appliances installed on ground supported concrete slabs or
                  floors shall provide for a minimum vertical movement of 4 inches of the appliance
                  by the use of approved metal appliance connectors or other methods approved by the
                  building official."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 9, 9-14-2020)
